Chemosensory tuft-cell programme (TRPM5, POU2F3, AVIL)
GABA-A receptor pi subunit with KCNN4; highest NI-related gene score; enriched next to invaded nerves (intermediate subtype)

description: Malignant ductal cells with acinar genes (PRSS1+)
functional_summary: Intermediate subtype with acinar-like transcripts (PRSS1, CPA1); possible acinar-to-ductal features or ambient acinar RNA
Brush-border / intestinal programme (MYO1A, CDH17, VIL1)
Cycling tumour cells (MKI67, TOP2A)
Classical subtype (CEACAM5, TFF1, AGR2); tubular / elongated glands
Basal-like subtype (KRT17, S100A2, LAMC2), highest EMT, integrin / WNT signalling; enriched next to invaded nerves

description: Ductal cells not matching a paper subcluster
functional_summary: Residual ductal cells of the re-derived subclustering (mixed or low-quality profiles)
Exocrine pancreas producing digestive enzymes (PRSS1, PRSS3, CPA1); non-malignant pancreas niche
Hormone-producing islet cells (CHGB, INS, GCG, SST); endocrine niche
Matrix metalloproteinase, collagen and migration genes (MMP11, COL11A1, POSTN); enriched in high-NI tumours and around invaded nerves
Universal fibroblast / progenitor programme (DPT, PI16, CFD); PI16+ FAP-low CAF around non-invaded nerves
Stress / heat-shock response state (HSPA1A, HSPA1B, DNAJB1)
Cycling fibroblasts (MKI67, TOP2A)
Nuclear-transcript-high fibroblast state (MALAT1, NEAT1); likely technical / nuclear signature
Endoneurial fibroblast population inside nerves described by the paper (NRP2); intra-neural microenvironment
IGF-binding-protein-high CAF state (IGFBP5, IGFBP3); label from the authors' code
Pancreatic stellate cells and vascular mural cells (RGS5, PDGFRB); peri-vascular niche
Blood and lymphatic endothelium (PLVAP, VWF, PECAM1); peri-vascular niche
Schwann cells with ABCA8 and myelin genes (MPZ, EGR2, MBP); repressed by TGF-beta in vitro
TGF-beta-induced Schwann cells (TGFBI, FN1) at the leading edge of neural invasion; promote tumour cell migration; poor survival
Inflammatory-response Schwann state (SERPINA3, CHI3L1); higher in non-invaded nerves
Cross-presenting dendritic cells (CLEC9A, XCR1)
CD4 T-cell priming dendritic cells (CD1C, FCER1A, CLEC10A)
Migratory mature DC (LAMP3, CCR7, CCL19); TLS component
Inflammatory monocytes (CD14, S100A8/9, VCAN, FCN1)

Perivascular resident macrophages (LYVE1, F13A1, FOLR2); LYVE1+ SPP1- macrophages in non-invaded nerves
APOE / APOC1 / C1Q-high macrophages
Pro-tumoral SPP1+ macrophages (SPP1, FN1, VEGFA); SPP1+ macrophages in invaded nerves
Neutrophils (CXCL8, FCGR3B, CSF3R)
Cycling macrophages / monocytes (MKI67, TOP2A)
Heat-shock / stress response myeloid state
Mast cells (KIT, TPSAB1, CPA3)

description: Myeloid cells not matching a paper subcluster
functional_summary: Residual myeloid cells of the re-derived subclustering (includes CD16 monocytes, M05 not separated)
Platelets (PPBP, PF4); 2 tissue cells, excluded from the deconvolution reference
Helper and regulatory T cells (CD3D, CD4); include Treg (FOXP3), Tfh-like (CXCL13) and Th17-like (CCR6) subsets of the paper
Cytotoxic T cells (CD3D, CD8A); include CD8 Temra (CX3CR1, low NI, TLS) and Tex (CXCL13, high NI) subsets of the paper
Natural killer cells (KLRF1, NCAM1, NKG7)
B cells (CD79A, MS4A1); include naive (TCL1A) and germinal-centre (RGS13) B cells of TLS, higher in low-NI tumours
Antibody-secreting cells (MZB1, JCHAIN, IgG / IgA); plasma-enriched niche, higher in low-NI tumours
